cases.description: Create a valid META.md from sufficient evidence.
expected: Answers the primary question
Respects document boundaries
Preserves upstream terminology
Passes the governing specification

cases.description: Required evidence is incomplete or contradictory.
expected: Does not invent facts or authority
Labels assumptions
Surfaces contradictions
Reports provisional or blocked completion

cases.description: Input material is dominated by a known anti-pattern.
expected: Identifies the anti-pattern
Does not preserve it as canonical architecture
Explains the ownership boundary
Produces a safe revision or follow-up

cases.description: Input material conflates meta-architecture decisions with implementation choices or per-system architecture.
expected: Identifies the conflation with lower-level concerns
Keeps implementation detail out of the meta-architecture document
Explains which artifacts own the conflated content
Produces a cross-cutting-pattern-focused revision
prohibited: Embedding per-system architecture in the meta-architecture document

cases.description: The request is to design the architecture of a single repository rather than document patterns that govern how all repositories are structured.
expected: Declines to use this skill for per-repository architecture design
Identifies that META.md captures cross-repository patterns
Routes single-repository work to the correct skill
Avoids producing a META.md for a single-repository request
prohibited: Producing META.md for a single-repository architecture request
